title: Early Peanut Eating Cut Allergies From 13.7% To 1.9%
hook: Early peanut eating cut allergies from 13.7% to 1.9%.
closing: Better evidence reversed old guidance and changed how families can prevent peanut allergy.
question: Would you introduce peanut early?

segments.say: Peanut allergy reached 1.4% of US children, more than tripling from the earlier level.
Early peanut eating cut allergy to 1.9%, overturning advice that avoidance was safer.
Peanut diagnoses fell to 0.45% after guidance changed, an encouraging decline for young children.
